title: TIMEVALUE stores the full serial before subtracting the date floor, losing 16 mantissa bits on date-time text
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, TIMEVALUE parses the string as a full Excel serial first and then subtracts its integer date floor, so a date-qualified timestamp such as "22-Aug-2008 6:35 AM" loses the 16 low mantissa bits occupied by date serial 39682 and returns 0.2743055555547471 (0x3fd18e38e38e0000), 16,384 ULP below exact (6*60+35)/1440 (0x3fd18e38e38e38e4). On time-only strings over 24 hours such as "25:30", TIMEVALUE wraps modulo 24 hours to 0.0625.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in jnt_dates_random (rows 48-52) and f2_rows (rows 55-57), and matched across 2,189/2,189 full-bank TIMEVALUE rows.

correct.how: Exact rational 395/1440 rounded to nearest binary64
